desk:
**BLUF:** The community is focused on the rapid Saudi-Houthi escalation in Yemen and the Red Sea region, alongside fresh maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz. The single most important thread is Saudi strikes on Houthi infrastructure met with immediate Houthi evacuation warnings and counter-threats against Saudi targets.

## MAIN THREADS
### Saudi-Houthi escalation
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110081872994685139) posted footage of today’s Saudi strikes on Houthi ports, oil facilities and Dhamar/Sanaa, noting Houthis are now targeting Saudi areas with Riyadh warnings issued.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110019890857816113) reported Houthis issuing evacuation notices for Aramco HQ in Dhahran, Riyadh refinery and King Khalid Airport, following Saudi hits on Ras Isa, Hodeidah and Sanaa.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110040668940783973) noted President Trump’s Truth Social comment that “The Houthis are behaving very badly.”

### Maritime security – Hormuz tankers
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110087559434887546) and [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2110084775260151888) both reported two tankers struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz, with UKMTO issuing Warning 171-26; [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2110084067349959033) also released Warning 170-26.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110087559434887546) highlighted the sharp rise in Iranian-linked strikes, with over six reported in the last 24 hours.

### French seizure of shadow-fleet tanker
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110038967240257621) reported French forces seized a Russian-linked oil tanker off Réunion yesterday; Russia called it “French piracy.”

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110087559434887546) claimed tempo of Iranian strikes on tankers has “picked up significantly” (unconfirmed).  
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110039665470325148) noted the seized tanker was flying an irregular Beninese flag (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110019890857816113) stated Houthis have already struck King Khalid Airport “in recent days” (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching whether Saudi strikes continue and if Houthi threats against Riyadh materialise; further UKMTO warnings on Hormuz traffic; and any Russian diplomatic response to the French tanker seizure.
